snippet.title: Midnight Custody - Trailer
snippet.description:
Midnight Custody is a short found-footage-style game where you wander through a eerie parking garage. It's a freaky, immersive terror fest that'll keep you on the edge of your seat!

Link: https://eduardscarpato.itch.io/midnight-custody-by-dagon-dev
